subject: MSA / Order Form: request to reorder exhibits + tiered fee allocation (SOW edits)
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@atlashealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reorder exhibits & fee allocation - Redwood SOW

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the drafts and we have two related asks before we move to signature:

1) Exhibit ordering: we need the Deployment & Data Handling exhibit to appear before Exhibit B (pricing/fees) in the MSA. Our internal controls require the operational terms to be surfaced up front for SOC/engineering review.

2) Fee allocation: the customer CFO prefers a tiered throughput pricing table (discount bands by monthly token/throughput) rather than the flat committed capacity line item in the Order Form. Attached is our annotated SOW and the MSA with a few highlighted sections.

Can your team produce a single redline that (a) reorders exhibits, (b) updates Exhibit B to a tiered fee table, and (c) reflects the small SOW edits (integration window, milestone split) we called out? Also let us know whether this would change the planned go-live date (aiming for 2026-09-15).

Attachments: Atlas_SOW_v2_annotated.pdf, MSA_redline_Atlas_trackchanges.docx

Best,
Sara
Sara Jenkins
Senior Procurement Manager | AtlasHealth
procurement@atlashealth.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@atlashealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reorder exhibits & fee allocation - Redwood SOW

Sara —

Appreciate the detailed notes and attachments. We can do a single consolidated redline. High-level plan:

- Legal will move the Deployment & Data Handling exhibit ahead of pricing and reconcile cross-references.
- Commercial will convert the flat capacity line into a 3-band tiered table (we'll draft two variants for you to choose from).
- Delivery will incorporate the SOW edits (integration window shortened by 2 weeks, split Implementation/Validation milestones).

We will aim to deliver an updated tracked document by end of day Wednesday (2026-08-11). If the tiered pricing introduces any billing or commitment changes that affect credits or start date we'll flag it in the cover note.

Quick question: do you want the pricing bands to be defined by monthly token throughput or by reserved GPU-hours? The CFO explicitly mentioned "throughput" in the call but happy to match whatever your billing ops prefer.

I'll loop in Karthik (legal) and Lauren (commercial) to coordinate the language. Can we schedule a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow at 1pm PT if that works for you?

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reorder exhibits & fee allocation - Redwood SOW

Thanks Mina — copying my notes here so we have a single thread for legal/commercial: 

1) Exhibit reorder: fine to move Deployment & Data Handling (Exhibit D) to be Exhibit A. Need to ensure all cross-references in main MSA and Order Form point to new exhibit label. I'll do a global find/replace and add a short exhibit index at the front.

2) Tiered fee table: Commercial should provide the proposed banding. From a legal perspective we need to: (a) define measurement period and meter (monthly tokens vs reserved GPU-hours), (b) include an "overage" calculation and grace period, (c) add audit rights for meter reconciliation.

3) SOW edits: small schedule moves are fine. For the milestone split, let's ensure acceptance criteria for the Validation milestone are explicit to avoid ambiguity on go-live.

Option suggestion for commercial to present (sample language, pick one):

- Option A (preferred): "Tiered Throughput Schedule" — Pricing table with Band 1 (0-5M tokens), Band 2 (5M-20M), Band 3 (>20M). Each band lists unit price per 1k tokens and a monthly minimum commitment. Measurement is monthly token consumption, meterible by Redwood console. Overage billed at Band 1 per-unit rate with 14-day reconciliation window.

- Option B: "Commitment + Credits" — Reserved capacity line with monthly commit in GPU-hours; unused commit converts to credits applied the following month. Requires different billing flow and impacts invoicing cycles.

Laur en / Jordan: please confirm which option you want Maya sales to present and attach a draft pricing table. Also indicate whether switching to Option A changes the invoice timing or triggers a minimum revenue warranty.

I'll prepare the MSA redline (exhibit reorder + audit clause + measurement language) once we lock the commercial table.

- Karthik
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@atlashealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasHealth Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reorder exhibits & fee allocation - Redwood SOW

Mina / team —

Thanks for the quick response and the options. Procurement and finance reviewed both options and we'd like to proceed with Option A (Tiered Throughput Schedule). Key clarifications from our side:

- Measurement should be monthly token consumption as tracked by Redwood's console (we'll need an exportable report for reconciliation).
- Overage: agree to 14-day reconciliation window but request a 30-day billing notice before overage charges apply (to allow internal budget approvals).
- Start date: we are still targeting 2026-09-15 but if the revised billing triggers invoice timing changes, we need a revised billing calendar before signature.

I've attached an annotated Order Form with preferred band thresholds and a sample excel with our suggested per-band rates (OrderForm_tiered-fee-proposal.xlsx). Please incorporate these into the redline and let us know if any of the items above require additional approvals.

Attachments: OrderForm_tiered-fee-proposal.xlsx

Best,
Sara

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@atlashealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reorder exhibits & fee allocation - Redwood SOW

Sara —

Acknowledged and thank you for the band thresholds in the spreadsheet. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) Commercial will incorporate Atlas' band thresholds into a draft Order Form and produce Option A redline (tiered throughput table) — Lauren will drop the updated Order Form in a single tracked document.
2) Legal will produce an MSA redline with: exhibit reorder (Deployment & Data Handling as Exhibit A), meter definition tied to Redwood console export, 14-day reconciliation with a 30-day billing notice addendum as requested, and audit/measurement language.
3) Delivery will update the SOW milestones and explicit Validation acceptance criteria.

We will deliver a consolidated tracked document (MSA + Order Form + SOW) by EOD Thursday (2026-08-12). If that timeline slips we'll flag immediately. After we deliver we'll schedule a 30-minute call to walk through the redline; propose Thursday at 11am PT.

For transparency I'm uploading the in-progress files to the Drive folder and will include the DocuSign envelope once Legal signs off on the structural changes.

Deliverables (anticipated): Updated_MSA_redline_Atlas_20260812.docx, Updated_OrderForm_Atlas_20260812.xlsx, Updated_SOW_Atlas_20260812.pdf

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
